body:
Hi EDG Team!

I would love to know your decision about moving forward. Any tentative date in your mind to list the project?

Hi!

Please don't worry. We won't delist your project. 

I am sorry to hear about your past experience with other exchanges. 

Coinstore is a pro project exchange. We have listed 150 plus projects so far and we haven't delisted any projects so far. And EDGEWARE is a top project. Onboarding it brings a lot of value for our own exchange. And there is no point of delisting it. I am sure a lot of our users will migrate to your DAO and join it. Coinstore is an exchange which is targeting to grow with the project. So, we take pride in onboarding your project and we won't delist it unlike other exchanges

Hi Amit,

Given Edgeware’s past experiences with exchanges similar to yours having a habit of delisting us after reaping benefits from their funding, how can we trust that your commitment to Edgeware isn't just another short-lived partnership?


BugZ
I am in favour of the offer proposed by [@Gmeister7](/profile/id/8682) . Additionally i don't think we would be needing the bot services.

Hi!

I totally got your point. To simplify the deal, we had taken approval from our management for 8K USDT & 2K USDT worth of EDG. If you want us to accept the total in EDG then we can do that. But we will have to liquidate it before listing considering we will be spending amount in the marketing from our own pocket. 

While listing the project, we generally requests to keep 5000 USDT & 5000 USDT worth of EDG in the market making account. That is the liquidity and it is withdrawable. 

If you were talking about the market making bot services, then the fees are 2500 USDT/Month. However, we can negotiate on that part. 4000 USDT for 2 months & 5000 USDT for 3 months. If you have your own market maker you can use it as well & we can provide you the APIS.

Thank you Amit for making this proposal.

I have a counter offer for this proposal, taking the current market scenario into account. Instead of paying the 10k USD listing fee in $EDG at its current value that is at approx. 0.0002 which would be 50 Million $EDG, I suggest that the 10k USD will be proposed at the rate of 0.00082 value of EDG which would be around 13 Million $EDG. This way, we won't put a significant strain on the treasury. You can consider liquidating when the market situation improves.

I would also suggest requesting the required amount for Market Making as well.
